description: AICRETE was founded by Parham Aghdasi in 2020 and is located in Silicon Valley. The company aims to reduce both the cost and environmental impact of concrete through a unique "recipe-as-a-service" approach that leverages artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, and domain knowledge. AICRETE's platform works with concrete producers to optimize local materials to minimize their concrete mixture costs and reduce their CO2 footprint by up to 35%.

Banyan Infrastructure is a powerful, end-to-end platform that simplifies and streamlines project financing for both lenders and borrowers. Our platform replaces traditional spreadsheets, email and pdfs with digitized workflows automated data ingestion, risk monitoring and contractual compliance for each loan.

BattGenie was started from the labs of Prof. Venkat Subramanian at the University of Washington. With offices and lab space in Seattle and Austin, and an all-star team with over 100 years of cumulative experience in the energy storage technologies, BattGenie is changing the landscape of clean energy with a new paradigm of software. BattGenie has access to a sophisticated state-of-the-art battery testing equipment including high current and high voltage battery and battery-module cyclers at Seattle and Austin.

BlocPower™ is a Brooklyn-based climate technology company rapidly greening American cities. BlocPower utilizes its proprietary software for analysis, leasing, project management, and monitoring of urban clean energy projects and its customers are saving 20-40% on their energy bills each year.

BlueDot Photonics is accelerating the deployment of next-generation solar technology by developing simple, cost-effective solutions to improve solar panel performance and durability. BlueDot's unique quantum-cutting technology makes today's silicon solar panels better. Up to 16% more energy, helping lower the cost of solar power by 10%.

Blue Frontier's mission is to transform buildings into sustainable, comfortable and interactive spaces through the commercialization of a revolutionary air conditioning technology. Blue Frontier’s AC system combines dew-point-style sensible cooling with liquid desiccant dehumidification to reduce electricity use by up to 90% (non-fan). Our system is able to solve an array of today’s largest sustainability problems — from the Duck Curve to peak load management, from humidity control to integration of intermittent renewable resources.

Calicat uses proprietary methods to discover and test low cost electrocatalysts, ten thousand times faster than any other method. We then apply those low-cost catalysts to a very low-cost, disruptive-design hydrogen electrolyzer. With our IP and the world's largest electrocatalyst activity database, Calicat is uniquely capable of solving a key challenge for the Hydrogen Economy: producing low-cost Green Hydrogen.

Cambium is developing the supply chain operating system for the $750B green building and timber market. Their platform for "Carbon Smart Wood™" transforms the way materials are sourced, processed, and delivered, leveraging proprietary technology to optimize each step of the supply chain, from log recovery (or harvest) to end-product sale. This platform enables Cambium to simultaneously meet growing demand for alternative building materials and resolve key operational pain points in the wood industry.

Daanaa is the only chip-based technology that allows energy to be transferred freely, safely, and efficiently. Through rigorous research, cutting-edge engineering, and a passion for sustainability, we partner with ambitious manufacturers to overcome energy challenges previously constrained by the limitations of physical hardware.

description: Gaiascope ('Gaia') is dedicated to maintaining planetary balance and combating climate change. The best way to drive investment in, and return from, clean power projects is to make those assets as profitable as possible. Gaia's focus is the electric grid of the future: building the 'brain' for, arguably, humanity's most complex invention to date. We provide our customers the capability to optimize returns of their renewable and energy storage assets with price forecasts and bidding strategies tailored to their needs.

Headroom (formerly Archetype) is a new type of application-building platform that empowers business users to create and manage their own high-quality internal tools, by using process and policy as the source of truth, rather than code. The three founders previously worked together at Palantir, where they designed, built, and brought to market a comprehensive no-code platform that has helped enterprises around the world increase their operational efficiency by shipping internal software faster than ever before. Now, they are building Archetype to bring these superpowers to every small and medium business, because all companies should be software companies.

Heimdal's vision is to develop megaton-scale DAC systems before 2030 to meet the world's decarbonization needs. Their technology aims to provide a scalable solution for removing significant amounts of carbon dioxide directly from the atmosphere, contributing to efforts to mitigate climate change and achieve net-zero emissions targets. Heimdal’s facility in Hawaii has already captured nearly 40 tons of CO2 per year using renewable energy. They are now working on a commercial demonstration facility called Project Bantam in Oklahoma, which will have the capacity to capture over 5,000 tons of CO2 annually.

HEVO was founded in 2011 by Jeremy McCool with a mission to eliminate global reliance on fossil fuels by accelerating the adoption of electric vehicles. The HEVO team spent nearly a decade on developing a cost competitive, third-party certified, manufacturable, and highly efficient wireless EV charging product suite. By enabling drivers to simple park and power up, HEVO paves the way for mass adoption of electric vehicles.

HST is a pioneer in applying search technology to accelerate the path to a zero carbon world. Their suite of digital solutions engages companies of any size to purchase radically more clean energy and make the world cleaner. View® applies it to clean energy development and Cue® applies it to clean energy procurement. Together, both platforms from HST enable more Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with balanced risks for cost-competitive, wholesale clean energy.

ION's radically different battery concept enables safe, high energy density cells without the use of precious raw materials like graphite. Instead of graphite, ION uses a ceramic cell design that requires no anode material. Its cell extracts the lithium already present in cathode materials and uses its highly conductive ceramic to plate it as lithium metal into engineered voids.

Loamist is the pioneering cleantech feedstock platform that connects suppliers of bio-waste streams with emerging cleantech startups focused on using these feedstocks to decarbonize industrial materials. As a catalyst in the cleantech sector, Loamist is committed to driving growth and making significant contributions to global decarbonization efforts.

Magrathea Metals is a San Francisco-based company founded in 2022 that develops and manufactures magnesium metal from seawater using an innovative electrolytic process. They are focused on producing carbon-neutral magnesium, addressing a critical gap in global magnesium supply chains.

description: Nth Cycle’s technology transforms the outputs of metal scrap, electronics recycling, untapped mining resources, and waste from existing mines into high-purity critical minerals ready to be used in new production. Nth Cycle’s unique, modular electro-extraction technology supports refiners, miners and battery recyclers as an alternative or enhancement to older, emissions-intensive hydrometallurgical and pyrometallurgical processes.

NxLite (formerly 3E Nano) is redefining what’s possible in high-performance glazing — unlocking unprecedented energy efficiency without compromising transparency or design. By dramatically reducing heat loss while maintaining crystal-clear visibility, NxLite tackles one of the building industry’s toughest challenges: cutting carbon emissions from windows at scale. It’s a breakthrough solution that makes net-zero buildings not just achievable, but economically compelling.

Pearl Street Technologies' mission is to enable a more reliable, resilient, and sustainable power grid through advanced modeling, simulation, and optimization tools. By leveraging powerful circuit simulation methods developed to study billion-transistor electronic systems, SUGAR™ (Suite of Unified Grid Analyses with Renewables) offers industry-leading convergence robustness for power grid analysis.

Polycarbin is a resource management platform that is transforming the single-use scientific supply chain of today into the sustainable, circular economy of tomorrow. With on-site sortation made simple with intuitive diversion bins, coupled with the visibility offered by proprietary waste analytics platform, Polycarbin offers an environmentally responsible and cost-saving medical waste management solution.

Pronoia is building the world's first physics-based battery to unlock large-scale energy storage. Pronoia is accelerating the transition to 100% renewable energy with novel energy storage technology that improves capacity by orders of magnitude.

Rain equips fire agencies to stop fires before they grow out of control, using automated aircraft stationed throughout high risk areas. Rain integrates with early detection sensors to dispatch nearby autonomous helicopters within seconds, so that fires can be contained within minutes.

Refiant develops a new class of AI architecture that replaces brute-force scaling with a more efficient, nature-inspired approach, reducing energy consumption while increasing capability. As AI systems scale globally, Refiant enables resource-efficient, cost-effective, and sustainable compute

Salient Energy supports a rapid transition to clean energy by making safe, sustainable, and affordable zinc-ion batteries to power the clean energy revolution, providing a scalable alternative to lithium-ion.

Sepion brings a differentiated approach to replacing graphite anodes with lithium metal by combining the latest in nanoscience, polymer chemistry, and cell engineering to safely unlock a 40% increase in electric vehicle range with a gigafactory-compatible solution.

Skyven is a decarbonization partner helping large industrial facilities identify, fund and build attractive solutions to reuse thermal energy and reduce fuel spend. Skyven is a nationally recognized leader in commercial and industrial decarbonization of thermal energy, backed by distinguished institutions such as the National Science Foundation (NSF), California Energy Commission (CEC), and the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA).

Sylvatex (SVX) is an advanced manufacturing technology company that collaborates with electric vehicle (EV) battery manufacturers. Their proprietary waterless process produces cathode active material (CAM) using fewer steps and less energy. We are addressing the core of the EV battery scaling challenges: cost, supply, and carbon footprint. The technology greatly reduces the time to produce CAM in reactors a fifth the size of traditional reactors. Thus manufacturers have improved capacity and return on capital.

description: TexPower is a U.S.-based battery materials company that develops and manufactures advanced cathode materials for lithium-ion batteries used in electric vehicles and energy storage systems. Its core innovation focuses on cobalt-free chemistries — such as lithium iron phosphate (LFP) and nickel manganese aluminum (NMA)—that improve performance while reducing cost, supply chain risk, and environmental impact. By replacing scarce and expensive materials like cobalt with scalable alternatives, TexPower is helping strengthen domestic battery supply chains and accelerate the transition to cleaner, more affordable electrification.

Texture turns fragmented energy data into a single source of truth that enables live automation, standardized integrations, and cross-system action for energy use cases like grid response, energy management, and distributed resource coordination. As the grid becomes more distributed and dynamic, Texture turns complexity into coordinated action.

Thea Energy is reimagining how fusion power gets built -- starting with a fundamental rethink of the magnet. Spun out of Princeton University and the Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory, the company is developing a stellarator, a type of fusion device that can run in a continuous, stable state without sudden plasma disruptions that have long plagued its better-known cousin, the tokamak. Traditional stellarators achieve that stability through magnets with elaborate, custom-sculpted three-dimensional shapes. This has historically made stellarators impractical to manufacture and maintain at scale. Thea's key insight is to flip that logic: instead of building complexity into the physical shape of the magnets, they use arrays of simple, flat (planar) coils and let software do the heavy lifting. The result is a fusion system that is not only more stable, but dramatically easier to build, service, and replicate -- a critical ingredient for deploying fusion energy at real-world scale.

Traxen Inc. is a pioneering company at the forefront of innovative solutions in the transportation industry. Committed to revolutionizing the movement of goods, Traxen specializes in the development of cutting-edge technologies that optimize fleet management and enhance overall efficiency. Through a blend of advanced data analytics, artificialintelligence, and a deep understanding of logistics, Traxen strives to create intelligent solutions that not only improve operational performance but also contribute to a more sustainable and connected future in transportation.

Type One Energy was born from a dinner conversation at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, where leading stellarator scientists decided to stop waiting for academia and build the next leap in fusion themselves. The founders didn't just study stellarators; they built five of them, including UW-Madison's HSX machine and Germany's Wendelstein 7-X, the world's largest. Their approach preserves the stellarator's defining feature (i.e., physically twisted, non-planar magnets that hold superheated plasma in a stable, continuous flow) but unlocks it with two modern breakthroughs: high-temperature superconducting (HTS) magnets that generate far stronger fields than conventional materials, and advances in supercomputing that enable plasma optimization at previously impossible precision. Together, these clear the barriers that kept stellarators confined to research labs for decades. The company is building Infinity One, an engineering verification platform at TVA's Bull Run Energy Complex in Tennessee, scheduled for 2029, followed by Infinity Two, a 400-megawatt commercial fusion power plant designed to put clean electricity on the grid.

VECKTA is simplifying and accelerating the transition to a more profitable and sustainable energy future. VECKTA empowers businesses to competitively deploy onsite energy solutions across their operations. In one integrated Platform, business leaders have access to actionable insights and a vibrant marketplace of vetted providers to confidently plan, assess, deploy and monitor their energy transition strategy with maximum efficiency.

By eliminating the need for large volumes of water, XGS Energy's solutions make geothermal production possible even in water-scarce regions.
